evals.prompt: Create a React dashboard card showing cluster telemetry: P99 latency metric, healthy operational status badge, and an action button to trigger node diagnostics using M.O.B Signal design system.
evals.expected_output: React card component with dark surface background, strictly 0px border radius, Space Grotesk metric, monospace badge, and green #00cc5c primary accent.
expectations: Uses rounded-none or strictly 0px border radius across all elements (no rounded corners)
Applies #00cc5c green primary accent for healthy status or primary trigger
Uses dark canvas surface hierarchy (bg-surface or bg-background)
Applies font-mono for metric numbers and status badges
Text on primary accent uses black ink (#000000 / text-primary-foreground)

evals.prompt: Build a dense operational data table displaying database queries: Query ID, Duration, Status, and an action dropdown menu, with row selection support using M.O.B Signal style.
evals.expected_output: Operational data table using square M.O.B Signal primitives, subtle green selected row fill, and dark muted headers.
expectations: Uses Table component with zero radius (rounded-none)
Uses bg-primary-subtle (rgba(0, 204, 92, 0.1)) for selected row background
Headers use secondary text color (#a1a1a1 / text-text-secondary)
Dropdown menu and trigger maintain square geometry without rounded classes

evals.prompt: Implement a diagnostic configuration modal dialog containing a cluster ID text input, an automated draining checkbox, a verbose logging switch toggle, and submit/cancel buttons.
evals.expected_output: Modal dialog with elevated dark surface (#202020), square form controls, green focus rings, and black-on-green primary submit button.
expectations: Dialog container uses elevated dark surface (bg-surface-elevated / #202020)
Primary action button uses text-primary-foreground (#000000) on bg-primary (#00cc5c)
Text input, checkbox, and switch toggle are strictly square with zero radius
Focus states use green focus ring (focus-visible:ring-primary)
